items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: I started my brother, Freddie Kepler... he is to play with Freddie. He is to play a violin with Freddie.

ctx.x: Okay, if you want to tell about... You want to tell a little bit about your life first, just when you were born?
You ask me the question, like you said. So, Kepler, I want you to ask me... I want you to give me some information. Oh, yes.
So, Mr. Kepler, can you tell us just when you were born? 1888. You can just sit down there. This microphone picks up everything in the room, even my talking.

items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I have students. Freddie Kepler, 253, 255. Tremont Street. Boston.

ctx.x: What are you taking? Looks like that might be one of those taken in Chicago once. Yeah, it was. That's a picture from Chicago. About the same time I have one taken with Big Eye. When they were both with the three old band. That looks like about almost the same set, the way. Yeah, it's the same thing. The way he's dressed, and I don't know. He can't tell. Nah.

I have one here. Yeah, I did. I have that other one over. I believe I have that other one over here. Is that working over there? Nah, this one here. Now, that's the one you might have been taking. Now, this here. This photograph taken. Over there, I have students. Freddie Kepler, 253, 255. Tremont Street. Boston. Boston. Boston, Mississippi. No, Massachusetts. That was taken in Boston. Oh, yeah. That's when he has a white uniform on.
Fine looking. White band cap. Yeah. Where was that taken, Lewis? What is that name? In Boston, Massachusetts. Yeah, Boston. It looks like a brass band.
